description: This file defines the Address class, a value object used in the OrderAggregate within the application core of an e-commerce web project. It encapsulates address-related properties such as street, city, state, country, and zip code, providing constructors and private setters for immutability and Entity Framework compatibility.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: A value object representing a postal address associated with an order, containing properties for street, city, state, country, and zip code.

methods.name: Address
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an Address object with specified address details.
